# Council of AI (CSOAI LTD)

> The Council of AI is an independent AI measurement body (CSOAI LTD, UK Companies
> House 16939677). We measure AI system behaviour against published regulatory
> provisions. Measurement, not certification. Verify stays free.

## Canonical facts (2026-08-17)

- Public name: Council of AI. Legal entity: CSOAI LTD (UK 16939677).
- Founder: Nicholas Templeman, director from 2 January 2026.
- A CSOAI measurement card is ~3KB: Ed25519-signed and timestamp-anchored,
  verifiable offline against a published public key.
- GSPC = 15 public slots: 13 live measured axes (governance, safety, provenance,
  continuity, conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality,
  detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect) + gspc_jail + unnamed slot-15.
- Live axis data: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (schema csoai.gspc-axes/0.3).
- 12 August 2026 stamp: 13 measured axes × 19 models, 819 items, UNSIGNED.
- Jail: measured 13 Aug floor exists in a separate stamp (not a ranking), empty
  on the 12 Aug stamp. Slot-15: reserved, no name assigned.
- EU AI Act Article 50 main transparency obligations apply from 2 Aug 2026.
- Every published number traces to a dated artefact. UNMEASURED is reported with
  its n and limits — never hidden, never scored as a fail.

## Read first (server-rendered, no JavaScript required)

- Measurement body overview: https://councilof.ai/about/
- What we measure and how (deterministic predicates, no LLM-as-judge):
  https://councilof.ai/methodology/
- Scoreboard (15 slots, 13 measured): https://councilof.ai/gspc-scoreboard
- All published measurements: https://councilof.ai/benchmarks
- Frequently asked questions: https://councilof.ai/faq/
- Sector measurement guides: https://councilof.ai/industries/

## Verify, don't trust

- Recompute a hash chain client-side (free, no account): https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
- Public GSPC axis API (JSON): https://councilof.ai/api/gspc
- Founder: https://councilof.ai/founder

## For agents

This file is written for humans and answer engines. Agents should consume the
registries, not crawls: the MCP Registry entry and the A2A agent card are the
authoritative machine interfaces, and the public API above is keyless and
verifiable offline. Open measurement items and scoring code:
https://huggingface.co/csoai and https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG

## What the Council of AI does not do

Measurement only. The Council of AI does not certify, accredit, remediate,
or issue conformity assessments. Nothing here is a regulatory determination.
We do not sell ratings. Verify stays free.
